text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Here it comes, here it comes! From here, the final straight!
Everyone's special moves are—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
This is gonna be a fierce contest!
Can't miss this! Come on, goooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, a crowd is gathering?!
I-I can't see what's in front of me...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ei, ei! Justice Jump!!
Even with this... I can't see--

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to see the finish line, Biko Pegasus was heartbroken...
